phrases.note: Standup: câu 1. Nói việc đã xong, không kể dài.

example.en: Yesterday I finished the login bug.
example.vi: Hôm qua mình xong bug login.

phrases.note: Standup: câu 2. Một việc chính trong ngày.

example.en: Today I'll work on the API timeout.
example.vi: Hôm nay mình sẽ làm timeout API.

phrases.note: Không bị kẹt. Nói rõ, đừng im.

example.en: Today I'll work on tests. No blockers.
example.vi: Hôm nay làm test. Không blocker.

phrases.note: Bị kẹt. Nói người / ticket, không xin lỗi dài.

example.en: I'm blocked on the staging deploy.
example.vi: Mình bị kẹt ở deploy staging.

phrases.note: Kết lượt standup. Nhường người sau.

example.en: No blockers. That's it from me.

pattern.title: Yesterday / today / blocker
pattern.pattern: Yesterday I finished… Today I'll… No blockers / I'm blocked on… That's it from me
pattern.explainVi: Standup 3 nhịp: hôm qua, hôm nay, blocker. Mỗi nhịp một câu. Kết bằng That's it from me.

exercises.prompt: Nói việc thật hôm nay: Yesterday I finished ___
Nói việc thật hôm nay: Today I'll work on ___

aiPrompt.scenario: Daily standup. You speak first, then a teammate replies. Push the learner to fill yesterday/today with a real ticket.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: Yesterday I finished…; Today I'll work on…; No blockers; I'm blocked on…; That's it from me. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Daily standup. You speak first, then a teammate replies. Push the learner to fill yesterday/today with a real ticket.
